title: Autumn Garden Arch
desc: A warm orange arch set in an autumn garden.

groups.label: Feature flowers
groups.blurb: The saturated orange mass shaping the arch, with white pockets for contrast.

items.role: Vivid orange hydrangea — the broadest colour block wrapping both sides of the arch.
White hydrangea clusters breaking the orange on the lower left and right feet.
White ranunculus tucked into the white pockets for layered texture.
Yellow-toned spray roses dotted through the mid sections (closest yellow in the library — orange-yellow roses are a logged gap).
Round orange pompom mums giving the arch its bold spherical accents.
Yellow-orange marigolds bridging the orange and yellow zones.

groups.label: Accent fills
groups.blurb: Small scatter flowers lightening the dense colour mass.

items.role: Yellow aster-style daisies scattered across the outer edges (closest match — true China asters are a logged gap).
Tiny white daisies sprinkled into the white clusters.

groups.label: Foliage & grasses
groups.blurb: Softening greens and feathery fills between the flower blocks.

items.role: Round eucalyptus leaves peeking between the orange blooms.
Fountain-like grass plumes adding airy movement at the arch edges.
Orange feathery filler foliage deepening the warm tonal shifts (matched to the mist-grass filler).
